+# DigestIT
+
+AI generates changes faster than people can read them. DigestIT tracks project
+diffs and explains each change at multiple levels of abstraction — from a
+one-line business summary down to line-by-line code detail — on a timeline
+dashboard, so humans can keep up with AI-driven work.
+
